artifact_inventory.purpose: Numerical verification of the all-order DCT-basis identity, parity separation, corrected diagonalization, orthogonality, and odd DCT-VI/DCT-VIII split.

limitations: The theorem treats real stationary AR(1) covariances with 0<rho<1. It gives an exact algebraic factorization but no new floating-point backward-stability theorem for accelerated Cauchy application, and does not cover negative rho, nonstationary models, or AR(p) with p>1. The previously published recursive odd-order method already has O(N log N) complexity; the improvement here is structural and nonrecursive. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with simultaneous-work risk from the recent companion preprints.
provenance: Numerical-linear-algebra analysis of exact AR(1) KLT factorizations and odd-order completion of the fixed-DCT rank-one structure in arXiv:2609.20221.
record_title: All-order fixed-DCT rank-one factorization of the AR(1) Karhunen–Loève transform
